abstract:
BACKGROUND: Lymph node metastasis (LNM) is an important factor affecting the prognosis of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC). However, there is a lack of effective methods to predict LNM. The purpose of this study was to investigate the potential value of MR radiomics to predict LNM of PDAC preoperatively by comparing the different phases of contrast-enhanced T1 weight imaging (T1WI).
METHODS: A number of 123 patients with pathologically confirmed PDAC were involved in this study and divided into training and validation cohorts based on a 7:3 ratio. A radiologist with ten years of experience evaluated LNM based on morphological abnormalities of MR images. Radiomics scores (Rad-score) of arterial phase (AP), pancreatic phase (PP), and venous phase (VP) were calculated by multiplying the sum of each feature by a non-zero factor of the least absolute shrinkage and selection operator. We then established the nomogram integrating the VP Rad-score and the tumor location using logistic regression. Predictive ability was assessed using receiver operating characteristic (ROC) testing, area under the curve (AUC), accuracy, specificity, and sensitivity. The nomogram's performance was evaluated using the calibration curve analysis, Hosmer-Lemeshow test and decision curve analysis (DCA). A comparison of AUC was performed among the Rad-score of the three phases using the DeLong test.
RESULTS: The AUC of the radiologist's evaluation was 0.590 in the training cohort and 0.411 in the validation cohort. The AUC of AP Rad-score, PP Rad-score, and VP Rad-score was 0.778, 0.776, and 0.946 in the training cohort and 0.753, 0.735, and 0.961 in the validation cohort, respectively. DeLong test demonstrated that the Rad-score of three phases had higher AUC than the radiologist's evaluation (AP Rad-score VS radiologist's evaluation [p-value = 0.005], PP Rad-score VS radiologist's evaluation [p-value = 0.003], VP Rad-score VS radiologist's evaluation [p-value = 0.001]). Besides, the AUC of the VP Rad-score was higher than that of the AP Rad-score and the PP Rad-score (AP Rad-score VS VP Rad-score [p-value = 0.001], PP Rad-score VS VP Rad-score [p-value = 0.001]). Both the calibration test and DCA showed the nomogram was effective and reliable, suggesting its potential clinical utility.
CONCLUSIONS: The Radiomics of VP of contrast-enhanced T1WI may be a promising method for predicting LNM of PDAC, which can provide a reference for the selection of treatment plans and prognosis evaluation of PDAC patients.
key_points_ko: 영상의학과 전문의의 판독을 통한 림프절 전이 예측 AUC는 훈련군 0.590, 검증군 0.411에 그쳤습니다.
정맥기(VP) 라디오믹스 점수의 AUC는 훈련군 0.946, 검증군 0.961로 동맥기(0.778/0.753) 및 췌장기(0.776/0.735)보다 통계적으로 유의하게 높았습니다(p=0.001).
정맥기 라디오믹스 점수와 종양 위치를 통합한 노모그램 모델은 췌장암 환자의 수술 전 치료 계획 수립에 유용한 정보를 제공합니다.
summary_ko: 본 연구는 췌장관선암(PDAC) 환자의 수술 전 림프절 전이(LNM)를 예측하기 위해 자기공명영상(MR)의 조영증강 단계별 라디오믹스(radiomics) 분석 기법의 유용성을 평가했습니다. 총 123명의 췌장암 환자 데이터를 바탕으로 동맥기, 췌장기, 정맥기 MR 영상의 예측 성능을 비교했습니다. 연구 결과 정맥기(VP) 라디오믹스 점수가 림프절 전이를 예측하는 데 가장 우수한 성과를 보였습니다. 정맥기 라디오믹스 점수와 종양 위치를 결합한 노모그램(nomogram) 예측 모델은 우수한 신뢰성과 임상적 유용성을 나타냈습니다.
title: MR radiomics for predicting lymph node metastasis of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma by comparing different contrast-enhanced phases
title_ko: 조영증강 단계별 비교를 통한 췌장관선암의 림프절 전이 예측을 위한 자기공명영상 라디오믹스 연구
